items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: in that band was Denny Morton, Quentin Jackson was the other trombone player, and Gene Simon. There were three trombones -- Gene Simon, Denny Morton and Quintin Jackson, who we called "Brutta".

ctx.x: Yeah, he was an actor, but he also was a trombone player, and so he had a group, and I played with them up there for 10 years. It was Conrad, Dick Welston, the piano player, there was Eugene Sedrick, formerly with Fats Waller, was a clarinet player, and Herman Archer, also from the Fats Waller group was the another trumpet player -- and the first time I met Big Sid Catlett was in Miami in 1935; he came there with Don Redman, and in that band was Denny Morton, Quentin Jackson was the other trombone player, and…

And that was the first time I had ever seen a trombone with a great big bell on it. I don't know where Denny Morton got this trombone from, but it had an extra large bell on it, you know? And it really was impressive to me.
